prompt: Use $prompt-rank-monitor for a fictional B2B analytics product. Build a concise prompt-rank monitoring artifact for three buyer questions across ChatGPT and Perplexity. Use sample observations, mark assumptions, include QA checks, failure modes, proof metric, and next action. Do not mention source identities or private evidence.

Use $ad-variant-matrix-builder for a fictional workflow automation product targeting RevOps leaders. Create a controlled ad variant matrix across hooks, proof, formats, and CTAs. Keep one primary variable testable per row and include QA checks, failure modes, proof metric, and next action.

Use $lead-list-prioritization-scorecard for a fictional B2B data product. Score six sample accounts by fit, intent, evidence strength, urgency, and route. Include disqualifiers, owner handoff, QA checks, failure modes, proof metric, and next action.

Use $campaign-preflight-qa-checklist for a fictional product launch campaign across paid, email, and chat. Produce a launch QA checklist with owners, rollback, consent, tracking, asset approval, failure modes, proof metric, and next action.

Use $marketing-agent-workflow-spec to specify a bounded AI marketing agent that drafts campaign briefs from approved inputs. Define allowed tools, human approval gates, telemetry, non-actions, QA checks, failure modes, proof metric, and next action.
